engine: HF transformers, eager attention (softcapping), seeded inverse-CDF sampler, no CodeStop

descriptions.BFS: explores a graph level by level with a FIFO queue, giving shortest paths in unweighted graphs
descriptions.DFS: explores a graph by going as deep as possible along each branch using recursion or a stack
descriptions.IDDFS: runs depth-limited depth-first searches with increasing depth limits
descriptions.Dijkstra: finds shortest paths in a weighted graph with non-negative weights using a priority queue
descriptions.A_star: best-first search ordered by path cost plus a heuristic estimate of the remaining distance
descriptions.Greedy_best_first: expands the node that a heuristic estimates is closest to the goal
descriptions.Bidirectional: searches simultaneously forward from the start and backward from the goal until they meet
descriptions.Bellman_Ford: relaxes every edge repeatedly to find shortest paths, allowing negative edge weights
descriptions.SPFA: a queue-based improvement of Bellman-Ford that only relaxes edges of updated vertices
descriptions.Floyd_Warshall: dynamic programming over intermediate vertices giving all-pairs shortest paths
descriptions.Quick: picks a pivot, partitions the array around it and recursively sorts the partitions
descriptions.Merge: recursively splits the array in halves and merges the sorted halves
descriptions.Heap: builds a binary heap and repeatedly extracts the maximum element
descriptions.Insertion: builds the sorted array one element at a time by inserting each into place
descriptions.Selection: repeatedly selects the minimum of the unsorted part and swaps it to the front
descriptions.Bubble: repeatedly swaps adjacent elements that are out of order until no swaps are needed
descriptions.Shell: insertion sort over elements a shrinking gap apart
descriptions.Counting: counts occurrences of each key value and reconstructs the sorted output from the counts
descriptions.Radix: sorts integers digit by digit using a stable sort per digit
descriptions.Bucket: distributes elements into buckets, sorts each bucket and concatenates them
descriptions.Tim_hybrid: a hybrid of merge sort and insertion sort over natural runs
descriptions.Builtin: calls the language's built-in sorted function or list.sort method
descriptions.Other: some other algorithm not in this list

s_j_rule: s_j = mean_band <Delta_h, c_j/|c_j|>, Delta_h = mean over 5 suffix positions of h_ban - h_placebo; classes without a centroid get s_j = 0
